div.head: Ine 20
div.ab: Gif feorcund mon oððe fremde buton wege geond wudu gonge ⁊ ne hryme ne horn blawe, for ðeof he bið to profianne: oððe to sleanne oþþe to lysanne.
LXIIII. Gif feorcund mon oððe fremde butan wege geond wudu gonge ⁊ ne hrieme ne horn blawe, for ðeof he bið to profianne: oððe to sleanne oððe to áliesanne.
Si quis alienigena uel ignotus sine uia uadat in nemus, ut nec ore clamet nec cornu sonet, pro fure probandus est: uel occidendus uel etiam redimendus.
{LXIIII} Gif feorcund mon oððe fremde butan wege geond wudu gonge ⁊ ne hrieme ne horn blawe, for ðeof he bið to profianne: oððe to sleanne oððe to áliesanne.

If [either] a person who has come from far off or a stranger travels off the road through the woods and does not shout out or blow a horn, he is to be taken for a thief: either to be slain or to be redeemed [by ransom].
If a man from afar, or a stranger, travels through a wood off the highway and neither shouts nor blows a horn, he shall be assumed to be a thief, and as such may be either slain or put to ransom.
If a man from a distance or a foreigner goes through the wood off the track, and does not shout nor blow a horn, he is to be assumed to be a thief, to be either killed or redeemed.
Wenn ein fernher stammender Mann oder ein Fremder abseits vom Wege durch den Wald geht und weder ruft noch Horn bläst, als Dieb ist der zu erachten: entweder zu tödten oder auszulösen.
If a man of distant origin or a stranger goes through the wood off the road and neither shouts nor blows a horn, he is to be considered a thief: either to be killed or to be redeemed.

note.label: paralleled
note.quote: This clause is paralleled in Wihtred §23 [L28].

note.label: cf.
note.quote: MP §47 suggests that the problem was the stealthy approach and not simply mistrust of outsiders

note.label: compare
note.quote: Compare §28, which allows a 10-shilling reward to one who captures a thief.

note.label: contradicts
note.quote: Ine §20/Wihtred §23 [L28] also seems to contradict Ine §28 – as it does Wihtred §21 [L26]
